new_defects.title: V-10's mutant (c) cannot make any specified adjacent_* test fail
quotes: plan/contracts.md:221: mutants: (a) make `one_tier_up` look two steps up (an `adjacent_*` test must fail), (b) drop the QoS filter from targets (a test must fail), (c) return all higher reasoning levels instead of the next (a test must fail).
plan/requirements.md (T-23): from a tier-3 model at its first of two levels, the first move is `more_reasoning` to its second level, and from its last level there is none
plan/contracts.md S-10 step 2: Unit tests named `adjacent_*` covering every observation in T-23, plus a test for each reading of the owner decision point
new_defects.why: Every fixture T-23 specifies for `more_reasoning` has exactly two levels. From the first of two levels, "all higher reasoning levels" is the same single value as "the next level", and from the last level both are empty, so mutant (c) produces byte-identical AdjacentMoves and survives. S-10 step 2 obliges tests only for "every observation in T-23" and no observation uses a model with three or more reasoning levels, so nothing in the plan forces a test that can distinguish the mutant.
new_defects.fix: Add one T-23 observation (and the matching `adjacent_*` test obligation) on a model with three or more reasoning levels asserting that `more_reasoning` returns only the immediately next level — or narrow mutant (c) to a mutant the specified tests can actually catch.

new_defects.title: Seven of the eight S-10 checks carry no expected result
quotes: plan/contracts.md preamble: Checks are commands with expected exit codes; "evidence required" is what the worker must paste into its completion report.

plan/contracts.md S-10 Checks: `cargo fmt --all --check`; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo test --workspace`; `cargo test --manifest-path crates/worker/Cargo.toml`; `cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/worker/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings`; `tier-drop schemas | jq 'keys | length'` = 11; `charter check --strict`; `gitleaks protect --staged --redact`.
new_defects.why: Every earlier slice writes the expectation out (S-01 `cargo build --workspace` exit 0; S-02 four checks each "exit 0"; S-05 five checks each "exit 0"); S-10 states one (schemas = 11) and leaves the other seven as bare commands, against the file's own preamble rule. V-10 then says only "reruns every S-10 check", so the expected result is nowhere.
new_defects.fix: Append `exit 0` to the seven bare commands, matching S-01…S-09.
